meta.title: We build calm, fast websites
meta.description: Acme Studio — a small team building content sites that stay correct after handoff.

properties.content: Acme Studio is a demo site for the Stelstone starter. Everything you see here is editable: open the admin panel, change this paragraph, hit Save — the live site won't move until you press Publish.
For editors: a block editor with drafts, per-page publishing and scheduled publish. Try editing the draft page in the admin — it exists there, not here.
For developers: every record is a JSON file in this repo, every publish is a git commit, and the whole thing — site, API, admin — is one Cloudflare Worker.
